source.source_name: DRCIP — Registrar of Companies (open CSV + eSearch)
source.organization: Department of Registrar of Companies and Intellectual Property (DRCIP)
source.license: Open data (data.gov.cy; confirm exact licence per dataset)

mapping_rules.registration_number: Use registration_number verbatim; entity type is encoded in the prefix.
mapping_rules.legal_name: Use name; preserve Greek and English forms where both are present.
mapping_rules.company_type: Map type (company/business name/partnership/overseas); refine Ltd/Plc from the name suffix.
mapping_rules.status: Normalise status (operational → active; struck-off/dissolved/under-liquidation as documented).
mapping_rules.registered_address: Use registered_address; parse municipality and district from the free-text line.
mapping_rules.officers: Map officers[] (director/secretary) — PERSONAL DATA; apply GDPR lawful basis + retention. Shareholders not present.
mapping_rules.activity_code: not_available — no public NACE/activity code in the open register.

fixture_requirements: company missing optional fields (no registration_date / single-script name)
non-company entity type (partnership / business name / overseas)

live_test_plan.smoke: Once the exact CSV resource URL is resolved via data.gov.cy/en/group/30, download a bounded sample and process the first rows in chunks.
live_test_plan.full: Download and process the complete DRCIP CSV only behind explicit env gates; preserve the raw CSV snapshot.

blockers: Exact data.gov.cy CSV resource URL not resolved (non-standard CKAN path: /api/3/action/* returned HTTP 404; group page JS-rendered).
Exact open licence per dataset must be confirmed on the data.gov.cy dataset page before redistribution.
Officer names are personal data (GDPR) — confirm lawful basis and retention before persisting.
